faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about aiBRAIN.
faq.a1: aiBRAIN is a central business knowledge base and control layer storing company identity, FAQs, prices, catalogs, and policies. Connected AI assistants query this repository to deliver verified, consistent answers across all communication channels.
faq.q2: What data can be stored in Brain?
faq.a2: You can add company profiles, operating hours, FAQs, product and service catalogs, pricing lists, refund policies, custom instructions, greetings, fallback notices, and calendar rules.
faq.q3: How is Brain different from a basic chatbot?
faq.a3: Standard chatbots are isolated in a single chat and frequently invent facts. aiBRAIN acts as a central control brain powering multiple channels simultaneously, answering only with approved business facts and escalating unknown questions to staff.
faq.q4: Which customer channels can be connected?
faq.a4: V1 supports Facebook Messenger, Instagram Direct, WhatsApp Business, Telegram, and website chat widgets. Knowledge is synchronized across all connected endpoints.
faq.q5: What happens if AI cannot find an answer?
faq.a5: When a query is missing from verified business data, Brain prevents hallucinations. It delivers an approved fallback message and transfers the conversation to human staff with context.
faq.q6: Can product and service catalogs be connected?
faq.a6: Yes, Brain supports structured catalog indexing via RAG. Assistants retrieve exact products, prices, and specifications directly from your indexed inventory.
faq.q7: Can appointment booking be scheduled automatically?
faq.a7: Yes, the system integrates with Google Calendar, enforcing your business hours, appointment durations, and availability to book appointments automatically or with owner confirmation.
faq.q8: Who updates policies and prices in Brain?
faq.a8: Only the business owner or authorized administrators manage data and rules in Brain. Modifying a rule once instantly updates responses across all connected AI assistants.
